families.verifier: Verification gate failures: the train report's next: line under each failure
families.trainer-process: Trainer and interpreter failures: the one line semantscript train prints instead of a traceback
families.teacher: Teacher and training-data failures: the next: clause of the trainer's error or warning line about an expression's constraints, examples or teacher spend
families.runtime: Runtime errors for a missing, stale or unloadable artifact: the next: clause of the error message and its remedy field
families.cli: semantscript test, run and build failures: the next: clause of the message
families.doctor: semantscript doctor and the train preflight: the fix: line under each failed or warning check
families.editor: Editor warnings from the language-service plugin: the next: clause of the warning

remedies.failure: `N gold/human example prediction(s) failed`, and two or more misses share a one-field rule
remedies.cause: The misses expect the same output and share one input field value or bound, every teacher-labelled case with that field agrees, and no constraint states the rule: the model is missing a rule the data implies.
remedies.fix: add the constraint always(() => {predicate}, {output}): the {count} missed examples all have {predicate} and expect {output}, and every teacher-labelled case where it holds agrees

remedies.failure: `N gold/human example prediction(s) failed`, and teacher-labelled cases are mispredicted the same way
remedies.cause: The model has not learned a region the teacher labelled; the misses repeat on generated cases.
remedies.fix: add the examples entry {example}: {count} teacher-labelled case(s) that expect {expected} are also predicted {predicted}

remedies.failure: `N gold/human example prediction(s) failed`, and no teacher-labelled case repeats the miss
remedies.cause: The example disagrees with what the model learned from the teacher's labels: the example, the labels or a constraint is wrong.
remedies.fix: check the example {case} against the teacher's labels (it expects {expected}, the model predicts {predicted}): semantscript explain <module.js> --call <export> with its inputs lists the nearest teacher-labelled cases and the constraints that apply; if the example is right, add examples near it or a constraint for its rule; if not, correct it

remedies.failure: `N adversarial constraint check(s) failed (…)`, and one constraint is broken by two or more records
remedies.cause: Raw predictions break the same always/never on several records: the region the constraint covers is thin in the training data.
remedies.fix: add the examples entry {example}: constraint {index} ({source}) is broken by {count} records

remedies.failure: a gold miss or a constraint violation while the head gets more than 5% of its own teacher-labelled training cases wrong (at least 3), or predicts one output for all of them
remedies.cause: The head underfits (too few epochs or cases, or a lowered learning rate), so one more example would only move the error elsewhere.
remedies.fix: rerun with --epochs {epochs} (now {currentEpochs}) and --cases {cases} (now {currentCases}), and the default --learning-rate if you lowered it: the head gets {missed} of {total} teacher-labelled training cases wrong ({detail}), which more training fixes before any example does

remedies.failure: `N adversarial constraint check(s) failed (…)`, and no constraint is broken twice
remedies.cause: Isolated violations, usually numbers close to a constraint's boundary.
remedies.fix: sample the boundaries more densely: rerun with --cases {cases} (now {current}), or accept isolated misses by recording a tolerance with --max-constraint-violation-rate

remedies.failure: `ECE x exceeds configured threshold t`, with fewer than 200 calibration rows or a head that already fits
remedies.cause: Calibration error after temperature scaling is above the gate, measured on few held-out rows.
remedies.fix: rerun with --cases {cases} (now {current}): ECE {ece} is measured on {rows} calibration rows, and more cases give more of them

remedies.failure: `ECE x exceeds configured threshold t`, with 200 or more calibration rows and accuracy below 0.95
remedies.cause: Calibration error after temperature scaling is above the gate, and the head underfits.
remedies.fix: rerun with --epochs {epochs} (now {current}): accuracy {accuracy} shows an underfit head, which calibrates poorly

remedies.failure: A violation-rate or ECE failure within the retry margin while the seed retry is off (`--seed-attempts 1`)
remedies.cause: The failure was narrow, the kind another seed usually fixes, but the retry was turned off.
remedies.fix: rerun with --seed-attempts {attempts}: the failure was narrow, and the retry trains the next seeds on the cached datasets without a teacher request

remedies.failure: A violation-rate or ECE failure within the retry margin after every seed attempt failed
remedies.cause: Every seed tried failed narrowly.
remedies.fix: rerun with --seed {seed}: seeds {first} to {last} failed narrowly, and the retry continues from the next untried seed on the cached datasets

remedies.failure: `N output type check(s) failed`
remedies.cause: A decoded prediction was outside the support; only possible with a corrupted head.
remedies.fix: rerun with --no-cache to retrain the head from scratch

remedies.failure: `unable to run <python>: spawn <python> ENOENT`
remedies.cause: The interpreter the CLI starts does not exist.
remedies.fix: run {doctor} and fix its python check: install Python 3.12 or later, or point the CLI at one with --python <exe> or SEMANTSCRIPT_PYTHON

remedies.failure: `semantscript train: the trainer stopped: ModuleNotFoundError: No module named '<module>'`
remedies.cause: The interpreter lacks a package the trainer imports; the check is trainer, model, torch or onnxruntime depending on the module.
remedies.fix: run {doctor} and fix its {check} check: {python} cannot import {module}

remedies.failure: `semantscript train: the trainer stopped: SyntaxError: …`
remedies.cause: The interpreter is older than the trainer's syntax (Python 3.12); on 3.12 or later a SyntaxError is a trainer-crash.
remedies.fix: run {doctor} and fix its python check: {python} cannot parse the trainer, which needs Python 3.12 or later

remedies.failure: `semantscript train: the trainer stopped: <Exception>: <message>`
remedies.cause: Any other uncaught exception in the trainer.
remedies.fix: run {doctor} to check the environment; if every check passes, rerun with --no-cache, and report a bug with the traceback if it fails again

remedies.failure: `error: fine-tuning requires PyTorch; install the project training extra` and the other `… training extra` errors the trainer catches
remedies.cause: A training package (PyTorch, Transformers, tokenizers, safetensors, ONNX) does not import in the trainer's interpreter.
remedies.fix: run {doctor} and fix its {check} check: {python} cannot import {module}

remedies.failure: `error: [Errno 2] No such file or directory: '<bundle>'` or a bundle that is not JSON
remedies.cause: No IR bundle at `--bundle`: `build` has not run, or the path points elsewhere.
remedies.fix: run semantscript build to write the IR bundle, or pass --bundle the build's semantscript.ir.v1.json (now {bundle})

remedies.failure: `error: bundle must be a semantscript.ir-bundle version 1 document` and the other bundle shape errors
remedies.cause: The file at `--bundle` is not the compiler's IR bundle, or was edited.
remedies.fix: run semantscript build and pass its semantscript.ir.v1.json as --bundle (now {bundle}); never edit the bundle by hand

remedies.failure: `error: teacher config file must contain only a [teacher] table` and the other teacher-file errors
remedies.cause: The teacher TOML is missing, malformed or has an unknown key.
remedies.fix: run {doctor} and fix its teacher-config check: {teacher} is not a valid teacher file (docs/teachers.md lists every key)

remedies.failure: `error: <teacher transport error>` after the teacher stopped answering
remedies.cause: The teacher's server was unreachable, refused the key or timed out.
remedies.fix: run {doctor} --probe request to test the teacher, then rerun semantscript train: the datasets that finished stay cached

remedies.failure: `semantscript train: the trainer was killed by <signal>`
remedies.cause: The operating system stopped the trainer: SIGKILL is usually the out-of-memory killer, SIGSEGV, SIGBUS or SIGABRT a native crash in PyTorch, ONNX Runtime or the GPU driver.
remedies.fix: run {doctor} and fix its torch and device checks, then rerun with a smaller --batch-size or with --device cpu: the datasets that finished stay cached, so the rerun asks the teacher only for the rest

remedies.failure: `semantscript train: the trainer was killed by <signal>` under `--estimate`
remedies.cause: The operating system stopped the trainer while it only estimated the run: --estimate trains nothing and sends no teacher request, so the training flags do not apply: a kill is a crash in the interpreter or a native library, or the host was out of memory.
remedies.fix: run {doctor} and fix its checks, then rerun semantscript train --estimate (it trains nothing and sends no teacher request); if it is killed again, report it as a bug with the signal

remedies.failure: `error: … out of memory …` (a PyTorch OutOfMemoryError or a MemoryError)
remedies.cause: The device or the host ran out of memory while training or exporting.
remedies.fix: rerun with a smaller --batch-size or with --device cpu: the datasets that finished stay cached

remedies.failure: `error: could not load the configured tokenizer: We couldn't connect to 'https://huggingface.co' …` and the other failed encoder downloads
remedies.cause: The pinned encoder (or the one --encoder-name and --encoder-revision name) is not in the Hugging Face cache and could not be downloaded: no network, a proxy, a hub outage, offline mode, or a model or revision that does not exist.
remedies.fix: check that this machine can reach https://huggingface.co (or the HF_ENDPOINT mirror, through HTTPS_PROXY if one is needed), unset HF_HUB_OFFLINE and TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE, or copy a Hugging Face cache that holds the encoder into HF_HOME; if you passed --encoder-name or --encoder-revision, check that the model and revision exist; then rerun semantscript train

remedies.failure: `error: could not create dataset cache directory: …` and the other file-system errors
remedies.cause: A path the trainer writes (the dataset cache, the artifact root, the report) is not a writable directory, or the disk is full.
remedies.fix: check that {path} can be written (a directory, with write permission and free space), or pass --cache-dir or --artifact another path, then rerun semantscript train

remedies.failure: `error: artifact export failed: …`
remedies.cause: The verified model could not be exported: ONNX Runtime failed, or the ONNX output differs from PyTorch beyond the parity tolerance.
remedies.fix: run {doctor} and fix its onnxruntime check; if every check passes, rerun with --no-cache, and report a bug with this message if the export fails again

remedies.failure: `error: counterfactual_ratio must be a finite number from 0 through 1` and the other option range errors
remedies.cause: A training option is outside the range the trainer accepts.
remedies.fix: correct the option the message names and rerun semantscript train (docs/cli-reference.md lists each option and its range)

remedies.failure: `error: <teacher response or generation error>` after the teacher's answers were rejected
remedies.cause: The teacher answered, but a case broke the contract (outside the declared types, a boundary pair that is not two-sided, a twin that breaks a constraint) on every attempt.
remedies.fix: rerun semantscript train: rejected answers are not replayed, so the teacher is asked again; if it fails the same way, use a stronger teacher model or a lower --counterfactual-ratio (0.5), and check that a single-field edit can cross the predicate of the constraint the message names

remedies.failure: `error: <message>` for any other failure the trainer catches
remedies.cause: A failure no other remedy classifies.
remedies.fix: if the message names a setting or a file, correct it and rerun semantscript train; otherwise run {doctor} to check the environment, and report a bug with this message if every check passes

remedies.failure: `<source>:<line> (<id>) has no gold examples: verification needs at least one attested example per expression, whatever the teacher`
remedies.cause: Verification checks the artifact against the gold examples, so every expression needs one, checked before any generation.
remedies.fix: add an examples: [{ inputs, output }] entry to the sema call, then run semantscript build and semantscript train

remedies.failure: `<source>:<line> (<id>): IR gold example <i> is invalid: case output violates …`
remedies.cause: A gold example contradicts the expression's own constraints or declared types.
remedies.fix: correct the example or the constraint it breaks in the sema call, then run semantscript build and semantscript train

remedies.failure: `constraint <i> is constant true (or false) and has no opposite predicate side` (`UnsynthesizableConstraintError`)
remedies.cause: The constraint's predicate has the same value for every input the teacher can build, so it has no two-sided boundary to verify.
remedies.fix: rewrite the predicate of that constraint over the inputs so that it holds for some inputs and not for others, then run semantscript build and semantscript train

remedies.failure: `the constraints do not decide every input, so the constraints teacher cannot label it alone. For the input {…} the constraints admit "a", "b"`
remedies.cause: The constraints leave that input open: more than one output is admissible.
remedies.fix: add always/never constraints until exactly one output is admissible for every input, or label the inputs they leave open with a language-model teacher: write a teacher TOML with [teacher] backend = "constraints" and a [teacher.fallback] table (backend = "anthropic" or "ollama" and its model), and pass it with --teacher <file> (docs/teachers.md)

remedies.failure: `the constraints contradict each other on an input … admit no output`
remedies.cause: Two active constraints require different outputs, or forbid every one, for the input shown.
remedies.fix: correct the predicates or outputs of the constraints active on that input so that exactly one output is admissible, then run semantscript build and semantscript train

remedies.failure: `it declares no constraints, so the constraints teacher cannot label it`
remedies.cause: The constraints teacher labels an expression only from its always/never constraints.
remedies.fix: add always/never constraints that decide every input, or let a language-model teacher label it: write a teacher TOML with [teacher] backend = "constraints" and a [teacher.fallback] table (backend = "anthropic" or "ollama" and its model), and pass it with --teacher <file> (docs/teachers.md)

remedies.failure: `its output is an object, and the constraints label scalar outputs`
remedies.cause: Constraints on a flat-interface output are not supported, so the constraints teacher cannot label it.
remedies.fix: let a language-model teacher label it: write a teacher TOML with [teacher] backend = "constraints" and a [teacher.fallback] table (backend = "anthropic" or "ollama" and its model), and pass it with --teacher <file> (docs/teachers.md)

remedies.failure: `found <k> of <n> distinct inputs the constraints decide in <m> draws`
remedies.cause: The sampled inputs are too narrow to reach --cases distinct inputs.
remedies.fix: write a teacher TOML with [teacher] backend = "constraints" and a [teacher.ranges] table that widens the sampling ranges, pass it with --teacher <file> (docs/teachers.md), or request fewer --cases

remedies.failure: `found <k> of <n> distinct inputs that the constraints decide and that one field edit moves to another output …`
remedies.cause: Too few sampled inputs have a single-field twin with another label, as for an expression that always answers the same.
remedies.fix: write a teacher TOML with [teacher] backend = "constraints" and a [teacher.ranges] table that widens the sampling ranges, or twin_filter = false when the constraints always give one output, and pass it with --teacher <file> (docs/teachers.md)

remedies.failure: `<source>:<line> (<id>) needs at least two independent row groups, but its <n> training rows (<k> distinct inputs) form one`
remedies.cause: Identical inputs, and each case with its counterfactual twin, stay on one side of the held-out split; in a small input space they link every row.
remedies.fix: lower --counterfactual-ratio (0.5, or 0 when the inputs are a few booleans or enum values), request fewer --cases, or, with the constraints teacher, widen the number ranges in [teacher.ranges] (docs/teachers.md)

remedies.failure: `warning: <source>:<line> (<id>): only <k> distinct inputs among <n> cases`
remedies.cause: Not an error: the teacher repeated inputs to reach --cases because the input space is small, so held-out accuracy covers fewer inputs than the count suggests.
remedies.fix: widen the input space the teacher samples (a [teacher.ranges] table for the constraints teacher, docs/teachers.md), or request fewer --cases

remedies.failure: `error: spend cap USD <cap> reached: the next request (about USD <x>) would take the run from USD <y> past it after <n> paid request(s)`
remedies.cause: TeacherBudgetExceeded: the run stopped before the request that would pass --max-cost-usd.
remedies.fix: rerun with a higher --max-cost-usd, or without it, to resume: every dataset finished before the stop stays cached in {cache}

remedies.failure: `error: spend cap USD <cap> reached: …` with the Anthropic backend
remedies.cause: As teacher-spend-cap; the Anthropic backend also journals every paid response.
remedies.fix: rerun with a higher --max-cost-usd, or without it, to resume: every dataset finished before the stop stays cached in {cache}, and the {count} paid teacher response(s) kept in {journal} replay at no cost

remedies.failure: `no price is known for teacher model '<model>'`, or OpenRouter's price list was unreachable or does not list the model
remedies.cause: TeacherPriceUnknown: the model is not in the pinned Anthropic table and not on OpenRouter's list. Without --max-cost-usd or --estimate it is a warning, and the run counts requests and tokens but not USD.
remedies.fix: check the teacher model name, or add a [teacher.pricing] table with input_usd_per_million and output_usd_per_million to the teacher file (docs/teachers.md)

remedies.failure: `SemaRuntimeNotLoadedError` (`SEMA_RUNTIME_NOT_LOADED`)
remedies.cause: A `sema` call before `loadSemaArtifact()` resolved.
remedies.fix: await loadSemaArtifact() once at startup, before the first sema call (semantscript run does this for a script); if no artifact exists yet, run semantscript train, or in a test load a stub with loadSemaStubArtifact() from @semantscript/core/testing

remedies.failure: `ArtifactLoadError` (`SEMA_ARTIFACT_PATH`): nothing at the path, or a directory without `current.json`
remedies.cause: No artifact was published at the path: `train` has not run, or the path points elsewhere.
remedies.fix: run semantscript train to publish an artifact at {path}, or point loadSemaArtifact(), --artifact or SEMANTSCRIPT_ARTIFACT at the root train published; a test that needs no training can load a stub with loadSemaStubArtifact() from @semantscript/core/testing

remedies.failure: `ArtifactLoadError` (`SEMA_ARTIFACT_PATH`): a symlink, an unreadable entry or a path outside the release
remedies.cause: The artifact root or a release inside it was changed by hand.
remedies.fix: point at the artifact root semantscript train published (the directory that holds current.json); never edit or symlink a release by hand

remedies.failure: `ArtifactLoadError` (`SEMA_ARTIFACT_INVALID_JSON`, `_INVALID_POINTER`, `_INVALID_MANIFEST`, `_INTEGRITY`)
remedies.cause: The pointer or manifest is malformed, or a file fails its digest.
remedies.fix: run semantscript releases list to find an intact release, then switch to it with semantscript releases rollback <release>, which also rewrites a broken current.json (pass --artifact <root> to both when the artifact is not .semantscript/artifact); or publish a new one with semantscript train

remedies.failure: `ArtifactLoadError` (`SEMA_ARTIFACT_INCOMPATIBLE`)
remedies.cause: The artifact was built for another runtime ABI, capability set or ONNX opset.
remedies.fix: retrain with semantscript train so the artifact matches this runtime (run semantscript build first after a compiler upgrade)

remedies.failure: `ArtifactLoadError` (`SEMA_ARTIFACT_QUOTA`)
remedies.cause: A pointer, manifest or resource is larger than the load limits.
remedies.fix: raise the matching maximum*Bytes option of loadSemaArtifact() if the artifact is expected to be this large

remedies.failure: `ArtifactLoadError` (`SEMA_ARTIFACT_RESOURCE`)
remedies.cause: A resource's tensors, opset or chain are wrong, or the native backend refused it.
remedies.fix: run semantscript doctor --runtime to check the native bindings, then retrain with semantscript train if they pass

remedies.failure: `SemaUnknownFunctionError` (`unknown-function`)
remedies.cause: The compiled call's id is not in the loaded artifact: the program was rebuilt after training, or the wrong artifact is loaded.
remedies.fix: the program changed after the artifact was trained: run semantscript build, then semantscript train, and reload; or load the artifact trained from this bundle (semantscript explain lists the artifact functions the bundle no longer has)

remedies.failure: `semantscript test`: `no artifact at <root> (current.json is missing)`
remedies.cause: Nothing was published at the artifact root.
remedies.fix: run semantscript train to publish an artifact at {root}, or pass --artifact for one published elsewhere

remedies.failure: `semantscript test --bundle`: `<id> example <n>: expected …, got …`
remedies.cause: The loaded artifact answers a bundle example differently: it was trained before the example changed, or from another bundle.
remedies.fix: run semantscript build, then semantscript train, and rerun semantscript test; if it still fails, run semantscript explain <module.js> --call <export> with that example's inputs to see the nearest training cases and constraints, and follow the train report's next: lines

remedies.failure: `semantscript test --bundle`: `<id>: absent from the artifact`
remedies.cause: The bundle has an expression the artifact was not trained on.
remedies.fix: run semantscript train on this bundle (semantscript build first if the source changed)

remedies.failure: `semantscript test`: a function whose verification status is not `passed`
remedies.cause: The release carries a function that did not pass its verification gates.
remedies.fix: retrain with semantscript train, following the next: lines of its report, or switch to a passing release with semantscript releases rollback <release> (semantscript releases list shows which releases pass)

remedies.failure: `semantscript test`: `current.json.release must be a string`, a missing manifest or another unreadable release
remedies.cause: The pointer or the release it names is malformed or missing.
remedies.fix: run semantscript releases list to find an intact release, then switch to it with semantscript releases rollback <release>, which also rewrites a broken current.json (pass --artifact <root> to both when the artifact is not .semantscript/artifact); or publish a new one with semantscript train

remedies.failure: `semantscript run --call`: `<module> has no function export named <name>`
remedies.cause: The name passed to `--call` is not a function the module exports.
remedies.fix: pass --call one of the module's function exports: {exports}

remedies.failure: `semantscript build`: `unable to read <tsconfig.json>` or TS5058 / TS5083
remedies.cause: No TypeScript project at the path; semantscript init wires an existing tsconfig.json but does not create one.
remedies.fix: create {config} with npx -p typescript tsc --init --rootDir . --outDir dist, then run semantscript init to add the SemantScript plugins, or pass --project <tsconfig.json>

remedies.failure: `semantscript build`: TS5092, TS18003 or another error in <tsconfig.json> itself
remedies.cause: The tsconfig.json parses badly or selects no input files.
remedies.fix: correct {config} as the errors above say (it must be one JSON object whose include or files select the .sem.ts sources), then rerun semantscript build

remedies.failure: `semantscript build`: `<tsconfig.json> must set compilerOptions.outDir`
remedies.cause: The build writes the compiled calls and the IR bundle under `outDir`.
remedies.fix: set compilerOptions.outDir in {config} (for example dist)

remedies.failure: `semantscript train`: `--teacher is required: no semantscript.teacher.toml, teacher.toml or .semantscript/teacher.toml found and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is not set`
remedies.cause: No teacher file and no key for the default Anthropic teacher.
remedies.fix: run semantscript init --teacher anthropic, openrouter, ollama or constraints to write a teacher file, set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY to use the default Anthropic teacher, or pass --teacher constraints when the constraints decide every input

remedies.failure: `semantscript teacher probe`: `no teacher to probe`
remedies.cause: No teacher file and no --teacher.
remedies.fix: run semantscript init --teacher anthropic, openrouter, ollama or constraints to write .semantscript/teacher.toml, or pass --teacher <teacher.toml>

remedies.failure: `node`: the running Node is older than the workspace's floor
remedies.cause: The CLI runs on an older Node release.
remedies.fix: install Node {minimum} or later (the repository's .nvmrc pins the tested release; nvm install)

remedies.failure: `runtime-bindings`: `@semantscript/core does not resolve`
remedies.cause: The runtime package is not installed next to the CLI.
remedies.fix: npm install in the project (the CLI loads the runtime from @semantscript/core)

remedies.failure: `runtime-bindings`: `<package> does not load on <platform>`
remedies.cause: The native ONNX Runtime or tokenizers binary is missing or built for another platform.
remedies.fix: run npm install (or npm rebuild {packages}) on this machine; the native binaries are per platform, so a node_modules copied from another OS or architecture does not load

remedies.failure: `python`: the interpreter does not run, or is older than 3.12
remedies.cause: `python3` (`python` on Windows, or `--python`, `SEMANTSCRIPT_PYTHON`) is not on the path or is older than 3.12.
remedies.fix: install Python 3.12 or later, or point the CLI at one with --python <exe> or SEMANTSCRIPT_PYTHON

remedies.failure: `trainer`: `<python> cannot import semantscript_trainer`
remedies.cause: The CLI runs outside the checkout without the package installed.
remedies.fix: install the trainer into {python}: pip install "semantscript-trainer[training]" (in a SemantScript checkout: pip install -e ".[training]", or run the CLI from the checkout, which adds trainer/src and model/src to PYTHONPATH)

remedies.failure: `trainer`: `<module> has no doctor command`
remedies.cause: The installed trainer predates this CLI.
remedies.fix: update the SemantScript trainer to the release that matches this CLI, or pass --no-preflight to train without the checks

remedies.failure: `trainer`: `<python> -m <module> doctor exited with status <n>`
remedies.cause: The trainer's doctor itself failed.
remedies.fix: run {python} -m {module} doctor to see the full error

remedies.failure: `trainer`: `missing anthropic, openai`
remedies.cause: The teacher client packages are not installed.
remedies.fix: pip install semantscript-trainer (installs the teacher clients anthropic and openai; in a SemantScript checkout: pip install -e .)

remedies.failure: `model`: `semantscript_model does not import`
remedies.cause: The model package is not on the interpreter's path.
remedies.fix: pip install semantscript-trainer (in a SemantScript checkout: pip install -e ., or run the CLI from the checkout so model/src is on PYTHONPATH)

remedies.failure: `torch` or `onnxruntime`: a package of the training extra is missing
remedies.cause: The training extra is not installed into this interpreter.
remedies.fix: install the training extra into this interpreter: pip install "semantscript-trainer[training]" (in a SemantScript checkout: pip install -e ".[training]"; for a GPU, install the CUDA or ROCm torch build from https://pytorch.org/get-started/locally/ first)

remedies.failure: `torch` or `onnxruntime`: a package is installed but fails to import
remedies.cause: A broken or partial install, often packages in the user site (`numpy.long`); with `platform-env` failing too, the variable fixes it.
remedies.fix: reinstall {name} into this interpreter (pip install --force-reinstall {name})

remedies.failure: `torch`, `device` or `onnxruntime` while `platform-env` fails
remedies.cause: The import or the GPU works once the variable `platform-env` names is set.
remedies.fix: {command} (see platform-env)

remedies.failure: `platform-env`: `<NAME>=1 needed: <why>`
remedies.cause: An environment variable the imports or the GPU need is not set; doctor proved it by retrying with it.
remedies.fix: {command}; {persist}

remedies.failure: `device`: `--device <name> is not a trainer device`
remedies.cause: An unknown `--device`.
remedies.fix: pass --device auto, cpu or cuda (ROCm GPUs are cuda to PyTorch)

remedies.failure: `device`: `querying it failed`
remedies.cause: PyTorch sees a GPU but cannot query it.
remedies.fix: check the GPU driver (nvidia-smi or rocminfo), or pass --device cpu

remedies.failure: `device`: `--device cuda requested but torch sees no CUDA or ROCm device`
remedies.cause: A CPU-only torch build, or no GPU driver.
remedies.fix: install the torch build for this GPU (https://pytorch.org/get-started/locally/), or drop --device cuda to train on the CPU

remedies.failure: `device` (warning): Apple MPS is available but unused
remedies.cause: The trainer does not use MPS yet.
remedies.fix: expect slower runs; lower --cases or --epochs for a first try

remedies.failure: `device` (warning): no CUDA or ROCm device
remedies.cause: Training runs on the CPU.
remedies.fix: if this machine has an NVIDIA or AMD GPU, install the matching torch build (https://pytorch.org/get-started/locally/); otherwise lower --cases or --epochs

remedies.failure: `teacher-config`: `<file> does not exist`
remedies.cause: `--teacher` names a file that does not exist.
remedies.fix: write a [teacher] TOML there (docs/teachers.md), pass --teacher <file>, or pass --teacher constraints (lower case) to label with the expressions' own constraints

remedies.failure: `teacher-config`: `<file> is not a valid teacher file`
remedies.cause: An invalid `[teacher]` table.
remedies.fix: fix the [teacher] table (docs/teachers.md lists every key)

remedies.failure: `teacher-config`: no teacher file and `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` is not set
remedies.cause: No teacher is configured.
remedies.fix: write a [teacher] TOML (docs/teachers.md; Ollama needs no key), set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY to use the default Anthropic teacher, or pass --teacher constraints when the constraints decide every input

remedies.failure: `teacher-key`: `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is not set; OPENROUTER_API_KEY is`
remedies.cause: The anthropic backend reads only `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, and `base_url` points at OpenRouter.
remedies.fix: {command} for this shell (base_url points at OpenRouter, which accepts its own key on the Anthropic route)

remedies.failure: `teacher-key`: `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is not set`
remedies.cause: An Anthropic teacher or `[teacher.fallback]` without a key (Ollama and the constraints teacher need none).
remedies.fix: {command} (an OpenRouter key when base_url is OpenRouter), or switch to the ollama backend (docs/teachers.md)

remedies.failure: `teacher-probe`: the Ollama server has no model `<model>`, or the backend answers 404
remedies.cause: The model is not pulled into Ollama.
remedies.fix: ollama pull {model}

remedies.failure: `teacher-probe`: the probe got 401 or 403
remedies.cause: The key was refused.
remedies.fix: the key was refused: check ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (an OpenRouter key when base_url is OpenRouter)

remedies.failure: `teacher-probe`: the Anthropic model is not found
remedies.cause: The model name in the teacher file does not exist.
remedies.fix: check the model name {model} in the teacher file

remedies.failure: `teacher-probe`: the Ollama server does not answer
remedies.cause: The Ollama server is down, or `base_url` is wrong.
remedies.fix: start the server (ollama serve) or fix base_url in the teacher file

remedies.failure: `teacher-probe`: a connection error or a timeout
remedies.cause: The network or `base_url` is wrong.
remedies.fix: check the network and base_url in the teacher file

remedies.failure: `teacher-probe`: any other probe failure
remedies.cause: The teacher refused the request for another reason.
remedies.fix: see docs/teachers.md

remedies.failure: An interpreter-level check fails and a `.venv` interpreter exists
remedies.cause: The packages are in the project's `.venv`, which the default interpreter is not.
remedies.fix: if the packages are in {venv} rather than {python} (the default interpreter), pass --python {venv} or set the SEMANTSCRIPT_PYTHON environment variable to {venv}

remedies.failure: `9150`: `sema expression is unverified: no trained artifact at <root>`
remedies.cause: No trained artifact under `.semantscript/artifact` (or the `artifact` option).
remedies.fix: run semantscript train (or semantscript dev) to publish an artifact at {root}; tests can use loadSemaStubArtifact() from @semantscript/core/testing without one

remedies.failure: `9150`: `the artifact at <root> cannot be read`
remedies.cause: The pointer or manifest is malformed.
remedies.fix: run semantscript releases list to find an intact release, then switch to it with semantscript releases rollback <release>, which also rewrites a broken current.json (pass --artifact <root> to both when the artifact is not .semantscript/artifact); or publish a new one with semantscript train

remedies.failure: `9151`: `not in the latest artifact`
remedies.cause: The expression changed since training, so its id is not in the artifact.
remedies.fix: run semantscript train; the build cache retrains only the expressions that changed

remedies.failure: `9150`, `9151` or `9152` on an expression without examples
remedies.cause: The expression has no gold examples, which verification and training both need.
remedies.fix: add a few examples: [{ inputs, output }] entries to this sema call, the first thing to try

remedies.failure: `9152`: `verified accuracy <a> is below <t>`
remedies.cause: Verified accuracy below `accuracyThreshold` (default 0.95).
remedies.fix: add examples for the cases it misses, or a constraint for the rule it breaks, then retrain (the train report's next: lines name them)

remedies.failure: `9153`: `expected calibration error <e> is above <t>`
remedies.cause: Verified ECE above `eceThreshold` (default 0.1).
remedies.fix: train with more cases (--cases), or set a confidence threshold with a fallback so low-confidence answers are caught
